archetype: The Clinical Precision Sentinel (Swiss-Nordic Medical Grade)

theme_strategy.rationale: Clinical diagnostic laboratories demand spotless, crisp, high-visibility white/slate backgrounds with high contrast for reading reference intervals, critical panic values, and specimen barcodes. Dark mode is available for low-light night-shift microscopy work stations.

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0_10px_20px_-5px_rgba(15,23,42,0.03)]
visual_enhancers.glass_header: bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_bento: High density grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layouts_and_grids.report_builder_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 with left panel (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4) for patient & test selection and right panel (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8) for dynamic result inputs and live printable preview
layouts_and_grids.test_catalog_grid: Search & filter ribbon on top, multi-category tabs (Hematology, Biochemistry, Endocrinology, Immunology, Virology, Microbiology, Urine/Stool, Routine), responsive catalog table with quick reference range edit and PKR pricing
layouts_and_grids.patient_record_layout: Patient header banner with demographics, specimen collection timeline, previous report cards, and interactive trend charts (Recharts line charts showing parameter evolution across test dates)
layouts_and_grids.print_sheet_layout: Strict A4 print preview with clinical header, ISO/accreditation watermark, barcodes, two-column test grouping, pathologist digital signature box, and QR code verification stub

role_based_staff_auth.description: Mocked fast staff login with single-click demo switch between Lab Pathologist / Admin ('Dr. Sarah Tariq - Chief Pathologist') and Senior Lab Technologist ('Hamza Ali - MLT Lead')
role_based_staff_auth.technician_view: Focused on fast entry of test values, pending queues, specimen accessioning
role_based_staff_auth.pathologist_view: Authorized to review, sign-off reports, edit test catalog & reference ranges, view revenue KPIs

categories: Hematology & Coagulation (CBC, ESR, PT/INR, Ferritin, Blood Group)
Clinical Biochemistry (LFT, RFT, Lipid Profile, Blood Glucose Fasting/Random, HbA1c, Uric Acid, Electrolytes)
Endocrinology & Hormones (Thyroid Profile TSH/T3/T4, Vitamin D3, B12, Testosterone, Beta-hCG)
Serology & Immunology (Widal, Typhidot, RA Factor, ASO, CRP, ANA)
Infectious Diseases & Virology (HBsAg, Anti-HCV, HIV 1&2, Dengue NS1/IgG/IgM, Malarial Parasite)
Microbiology & Urinalysis (Urine Routine Examination, Culture & Sensitivity, Stool R/E)
fields_per_test: parameters (sub-tests with units, male/female/child normal ranges, critical panic thresholds)

report_generator_flow: Step 1: Patient Selection or Quick Add (MR Number, Name, Age, Gender, Contact, Referring Physician)
Step 2: Test Multi-Picker with search across 700+ tests and category filters + price calculator in PKR
Step 3: Result Input Matrix with auto-flagging of High/Low based on patient gender and reference range
Step 4: Clinical Comments & Pathologist Sign-off notes
Step 5: Live Print-ready PDF Preview modal with one-click window.print() styling and downloadable structured report
key_features_blueprint.trend_analytics: Patient profile shows historical line chart comparing repeated tests (e.g. HbA1c over past 6 months, Fasting Glucose, Hemoglobin, Platelets, ALT/SGPT) with shaded normal reference boundary.

media.brand_logo_svg: Custom inline SVG with intersecting red blood droplet, deep navy DNA double-helix spiral, and clinical teal precision crosshairs/microscope bezel

pwa_and_offline_spec.name: LabCare Clinical Laboratory LIS
desktop_features: Full keyboard shortcuts for numeric test result entry (Tab + Enter)

testing_attributes_contract.rule: Every interactive input, button, table row, filter, and modal MUST contain role-based kebab-case data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React JS application in /app/frontend using existing shadcn components, Lucide icons, recharts, and Tailwind CSS.
Do NOT use .tsx or TypeScript since the project is JavaScript (.js / .jsx).

Provide rich pre-loaded clinical data: at least 35-50+ realistic lab tests spanning Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFT), Renal Function Tests (RFT), Lipid Profile, Thyroid Panel, Blood Glucose Fasting/Random, Dengue, and HbA1c with exact medical units (g/dL, mg/dL, U/L, %, mmol/L) and adult reference intervals.
Provide 8-12 pre-loaded patient cases with realistic Pakistani names, MR numbers (e.g. LC-2025-0142), ages, referring physicians, and report history.

Include a Dedicated Print CSS layout (@media print) for reports so when clicking 'Print Report' or 'Download PDF', standard browser print looks like a high-end pathology laboratory document with lab logo header, patient barcode, dual columns, normal range column, abnormal flags in bold/brackets, and digital pathologist signature seal.
Include interactive Trend Charts (using recharts) when inspecting a patient's history to visualize test result progression across dates.
Implement search and category filters for the test catalog and patient records.
Include PWA manifest and service worker registration hook for installability on Windows Desktop and Android/iOS tablets.
Ensure 100% WCAG AA contrast compliance and include all required data-testid attributes.
